title: 衣扣上的命数
mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 农夫的岳父在时装宴上倒下。那件时髦外套的羽毛扣饰令人着迷，林澈却注意到扣件没有扣紧。
宾客害怕是命数。林澈拆开看似完美的扣件，发现劣质弹簧与一根毒针；疲劳并非死因。
胆大的侍女交出传真订单。两种拼写相同的优惠说明暴露了进口商，修复扣件成了可行的救人办法。

The man collapsed. Guests blamed [[fate]]; a [[fearful]] waiter suspected [[fatigue]]. Lin found a [[fault]] in the apparently [[faultless]] clasp. A [[faulty]] spring exposed a [[fatal]] needle, giving their [[fear]] a reason.

A [[fearless]] maid ran [[farther]] to retrieve a [[fax]]. It promised a [[favor]] and [[favorable]] terms; the British copy offered a [[favour]] and [[favourable]] terms for the same [[favourite]] coat. Both bore the importer’s signature. Repairing the spring was [[feasible]], and the trapped needle identified its maker.

资金账本显示是一家公司为骗局筹款。磨细灯丝由有限电量的小电池供电，并非反应堆；最终调查员凭稳固证据揭穿真凶。
en: A [[fireman]] found [[fiction]] in a [[fireplace]]: a story of deadly [[fission]]. A [[fisherman]] had seen only a [[firework]], although the author claimed to be a [[first-rate]] scientist.

Lin lifted a [[filament]] with one [[finger]] and used a [[filter]] to remove [[filth]] from a jar. A broken [[figure]] and blood showed a [[fierce]] [[fight]]. Its surviving [[fighter]] had struck with his [[fist]], leaving the victim to burn.

A [[file]] revealed that a [[firm]] had agreed to [[finance]] the deception. Its [[financial]] records supported the [[finding]]. The [[finely]] cut wire drew power from a small battery with a [[finite]] charge, not a reactor. At the [[final]] hearing, Lin’s [[firmness]] defeated the killer’s story, and the family [[finally]] learned the truth.

一片漆屑、一只烧瓶和灯塔侧翼的火焰揭示了破绽。有人把金属板压平，企图让光线闪过海面，引走船队。
嫌疑人曾用甜言蜜语讨好厨师，夸赞每一种调味。林澈掀开金属板，制止逃跑的人，船队得以避开暗礁。

箱里只有面粉和治流感的药。云岚以柔韧身法穿过水流，按压受伤者伤口，将他带上高地。
水位不断波动。流利诵诀的老人利用荧光粉指路，泡沫中的箭羽轻颤，救援终于抵达最后一家。

It contained [[flour]] and remedies for [[flu]]. Yun’s [[flexible]] movements carried an injured man through the [[flow]] of water. His torn [[flesh]] worried her, but she kept pressure on the wound while the current shifted in constant [[flux]].

Water levels continued to [[fluctuate]]. Each [[fluctuation]] threatened the rescue. A [[fluent]] chanter marked the way with [[fluorescent]] powder dissolved in [[fluid]]. A feather began to [[flutter]] above the [[foam]]. They followed it to the last family, whose garden would [[flourish]] again.

云岚禁止弟子盲从，专注脚印方向。在接下来的岔路，她识破诱饵；愚蠢的骗子被抓，村民却选择宽恕。

A [[fortnight]] later, a [[fossil]] inside the false seal proved its source. The guards were [[fortunate]]: reinforcements had arrived. [[fortunately|Fortunately]], no one died. At the [[forum]], Yun urged leaders to [[foster]] trust and protect villagers rather than let a stranger’s [[fortune]] decide their lives.

脆弱的石框裂开，碎片带着花香。云岚扶住虚弱老人，发现花香来自故意倾入泉水的药剂，并非自然芳香。
外来工匠坦言施工图来自法国，框架承不了新水压。云岚拆除附加支架，追回诈骗款，泉水恢复，惊慌的村民终于安定。

她进一步核对记录，两种拼写的履约条款内容一致。铸剑师被要求履行承诺，别再小题大做；村民的葬礼也终于有钱举办。

cn: 港口接待员被指控泄露名单。她手袋里的手册与分发材料都被翻过，字迹却不是她的。
一个英俊的帮工把手帕挂在把手上，掩盖缝中的硬件。旁人只看见一把散纸，几乎没注意到另一版港口拼写。
林澈拆开把手，发现装置已硬化。尽管经历艰难与行动不便，接待员仍坚持工作；真正的泄密者得到查证，她恢复快乐。
en: A clerk’s [[handbag]] held a [[handbook]] and a [[handout]] about the [[harbor]]. Suspicious [[handwriting]] named a different [[harbour]]. Someone had planted both documents.

A [[handsome]] helper used a [[handkerchief]] to [[hang]] a cover over the [[handle]]. Hidden [[hardware]] sat inside. A [[handful]] of loose papers made it [[handy]] to conceal the altered list; few noticed what could [[happen]] to the ships.

Lin watched the glue [[harden]] and exposed the device. The clerk’s old [[handicap]] had [[hardly]] stopped her through years of [[hardship]]; she was [[hardy]], not careless. Her [[happiness]] returned when the real thief’s prints appeared beneath the cover.

title: 孵化室里的急令
mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 一只野兔闯进孵化室，警报声惊动山门。弟子匆忙搬草料，傲慢管事却命令他们冒险搬出发烫的鸟蛋。
有人怨恨云岚阻拦，以为她妨碍收获。她用琴与竖琴调和阵法，指出刺耳声音会伤害幼鸟；猛禽盘旋并非鬼魂作祟。
云岚制止草率决定，系上安全挽具，把鸟蛋拖到凉处。幼鸟顺利孵出，众人的憎恨化作和谐。
en: A [[hare]] ran into the room where spirit birds would [[hatch]]. Disciples began to [[haul]] [[hay]] in [[haste]]. Their [[hasty]], [[haughty]] supervisor ordered them to [[hasten]] into the heat despite its [[hazardous]] air.

Some began to [[hate]] Yun for delaying the [[harvest]]. Her [[harp]] restored [[harmony]] to the ward. [[harsh|Harsh]] noise could [[harm]] the birds; its [[harmful]] force, not the [[hawk]] outside, would [[haunt]] this place with loss.

She stopped the [[hassle]], secured a [[harness]], and moved the eggs to shade. The birds hatched into [[harmonious]] song. The supervisor’s [[hateful]] words lost their power, and his disciples’ [[hatred]] softened into relief.

title: 校长室的炉火
mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 新闻标题说学校被火吞没，总部立即调查。校长头痛不已，不知炉边材料为何起火。
听证前，林澈抬起暖气机，发现供暖阀门被动过。热情送茶的厨师鞋跟留下划痕，屋外树篱藏着烧剩账页。
厨师仓促毁账，却留下证据。伤者逐渐康复，校长承认疏于照管，藏账者也无法用祈祷逃责。
en: A [[headline]] about the school fire reached [[headquarters]]. The letter’s [[heading]] demanded an inquiry. The [[headmaster]] complained of a [[headache]] beside a burned [[heap]] at the [[hearth]].

Before the [[hearing]], Lin gave a [[heave]] to lift the [[heater]]. Someone had increased the [[heat]] by altering the [[heating]] valve. A cook’s [[hearty]] welcome concealed his fear: his [[heel]] had scraped the wall behind the [[hedge]] that hid the ledger.

The cook had rushed [[headlong]] to burn it. His guilt weighed [[heavily]] on him. The injured began to [[heal]], and the headmaster admitted his neglect. A prayer to [[heaven]] could not erase the evidence.

title: 继承人的高空求救
mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 继承人困在山峰，直升机在高处悬停。女英雄戴紧头盔，循药草旁山羊群留下的路径攀登。
山顶热如地狱，守卫犹豫。她说这片土地的遗产是救援知识，不是神迹；洞中母鸡的警叫正是风暴预兆。
她加固绳索救下无助的人。自此继承人资助救援，学会接受有益建议，村民把她当作真正英雄。
en: An [[heir]] waited at a dangerous [[height]]. A [[helicopter]] hovered while the [[heroine]] secured her [[helmet]]. A [[herd]] beside a patch of [[herb]] showed a safer path.

A [[hesitant]] guard began to [[hesitate]]. The summit felt like [[hell]]. The rescuer called their knowledge a [[heritage]], not magic. In this [[hemisphere]], storms came quickly; a [[hen]] in a cave had been their first [[herald]].

She had to [[heighten]] the rope’s tension to save the [[helpless]] man. [[hence|Hence]], he funded rescue teams; [[henceforth]], he listened to [[helpful]] advice. Her [[heroic]] act made her a [[hero]] to the valley.

mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 徒步者在山坡高速路受阻，山门等级制度也阻挠调查。云岚隐藏徽章，检查材料不一致的门铰链。
提示引她雇来腰伤的铁匠。漏气嘶声比传说更重要，她要让报告突出安全隐患。
历史学者检查历年修缮档案，证实阀门被施工撞坏。这次有意义的调查改变规矩，地位不能阻拦安全检查。
en: A [[hike]] on the [[hillside]] ended at a blocked [[highway]]. The sect’s [[hierarchy]] would [[hinder]] inquiry. Yun had to [[hide]] her badge to study a [[hinge]], whose material [[heterogeneity]] was [[highly]] unusual.
A [[hint]] led her to [[hire]] a smith. His injured [[hip]] slowed him, but the valve’s [[hiss]] mattered more than old stories. Her report would [[highlight]] this [[hindrance]] to safety.

A [[historian]] checked [[historical]] repairs throughout the gate’s [[history]]. [[hitherto|Hitherto]], none had failed this way. The valve had taken a [[hit]] during construction. The [[historic]] inquiry changed the rules: rank could no longer prevent a safety review.

title: 空心圣钟
mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 老人修圣钟的爱好坚持多年，沙哑嗓音和诚实记录让人信任。锄头放在架下，吊钩却被换了。
蜜月夫妇认为空心钟声不祥。钟表面均匀，内部却被蜂蜜堵住，云岚用家常小刀露出孔洞。
她吊起钟，拦住想跳过架下的孩子。绝望的钟主重获希望，愿意承认修理不完美的诚实让他得到尊重。
en: An elder’s [[hobby]] was repairing a [[holy]] bell. His [[hoarse]] voice praised [[honesty]], and his [[honest]] records listed every [[hole]]. A [[hoe]] lay beneath the stand, but its [[hook]] had been replaced.
A couple on their [[honeymoon]] feared the [[hollow]] sound. The bell looked [[homogeneous]], but hidden [[honey]] muffled one side. Yun used a [[homely]] knife to uncover the hole.

She began to [[hoist]] the bell and stopped a child’s reckless [[hop]] beneath it. Its [[hopeless]] owner became [[hopeful]]. The village gave him [[honour]] for being [[honourable]] enough to admit an imperfect repair.

绑匪把人质带进住房区。警犬嚎叫，直升机悬停。主妇抱着孩子，发现绑匪藏下的湿绳。
林澈看出倾斜船体上的水线证明绑匪后来才上船。主人先帮助伤者入院，再把证据交出，恐惧终于平息。

The waterline proved he had boarded late. [[however|However]], the prisoner’s [[horror]] was real. The [[host]] helped [[hospitalize]] the injured child before handing Lin the evidence.

飓风带来恐慌，有人要出门狩猎。云岚叫大家安静，检查液压门与氢气瓶，发现烃燃料泄漏。
她逐一验证假设，阻止抛掷火把。救援队保护每个人，轻松的话使人安定，天亮时屋内响起欢呼。

cn: 忠诚搬运工在月下追赶豪华卡车，丢失行李与木材让他背上赔偿。休息室的大喇叭却把他称作幸运赢家。
他的恋人找出一个发光团块，提醒他润滑轴承、降低车架。噪声不是劫匪，而是未固定好的木料。
午餐时，工人因肺病停工，经理竟用奖励诱他加班。林澈揭穿以奢侈为饵的骗局，忠诚不该成为索取劳动的借口。
en: A [[loyal]] porter chased a [[luxurious]] [[lorry]] under [[lunar]] light. Missing [[luggage]] and [[lumber]] threatened a [[loss]], yet a [[loudspeaker]] in the [[lounge]] called him [[lucky]]. Such [[luck]] sounded false.
His [[lover]] found a [[luminous]] [[lump]] beside the axle. She helped [[lubricate]] it and [[lower]] the frame. A [[loud]] rattle came from loose wood, which he might [[lose]] without repairs.

At [[luncheon]], his [[lung]] illness forced a rest. The manager’s promise of [[luxury]] was a [[lure]] for unpaid work. Lin’s inspection restored the cargo and showed that [[loyalty]] did not require accepting exploitation.

mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然

在大陆来的侍女帮忙下，林澈把主机与磁铁分开。所谓魔法主要靠磁性，穿制服的女主人被他礼貌询问。
他放大故障痕迹，发现主要线路被人为改过。魔术师承认夸大磁力，女士们得到答谢，观众也不再被当成疯子。
en: A [[magazine]] praised a [[magician]]’s [[magic]]. A [[maid]] found neglected [[machinery]] and asked the [[magistrate]] to inspect it. A [[magnificent]] effect did not prove great [[magnitude]].

mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 陛下的商场发生医疗事故，多数人怀疑男店长怀有恶意。管理员发现那其实是管理混乱与疏忽造成。
巡使灵活绕过狭窄走道，在豪宅保险箱里找到手册。表面男子气概不能替代正确举止，负责人不得不听见普通人的声音。
事件明确后，主要责任被归于失职，恶意造谣也停止。商场救下受伤哺乳动物，提醒众人善待人类也善待动物。
en: At His [[majesty|Majesty]]’s [[mall]], a [[major]] accident led the [[majority]] to blame a [[male]] manager’s [[malice]]. A nurse found [[malpractice]], not proof of a [[malicious]] plot.

Good [[management]] needed more than [[managerial]] pride. Lin used a careful [[maneuver]] to [[manage]] the crowd, then another [[manoeuvre]] to reach a [[mansion]]’s safe. Its [[manual]] made the fault [[manifest]].

The manager’s [[makeup]] concealed fear. A [[manly]] pose could not replace a responsible [[manner]]. He accepted the ruling and rescued an injured [[mammal]]. Caring for [[mankind]] began with admitting what his own system had done.

枫树下的马拉松集市里，制造者兜售大理石纪念品。潮湿沼泽中的标记却表明矿场是空的，所谓海事财富只是边缘地块。
新郎想结婚却拒绝以谎言维系婚姻。元帅查封骗局，给被炒作成烈士的工人恢复真实姓名，大家赞叹真相比奇迹更有用。
en: A [[manufacturer]] delivered a [[manuscript]] promising a [[marriage]] fortune. The bride read a [[marginal]] note in its [[margin]] before agreeing to [[marry]]. A [[married]] couple would inherit a [[maritime]] mine.

At a [[marathon]] [[market]] under a [[maple]], workers would [[manufacture]] [[marble]] tokens. Lin followed a [[mark]] into a [[marsh]] and found no mine. The seller’s chart showed [[mars|Mars]], a distraction from worthless land.

A [[marshal]] stopped the fraud and restored the name of a worker called a [[martyr]] in false advertising. The couple could [[marvel]] at their narrow escape. A [[marvellous]] rescue was also [[marvelous]] for being true.

cn: 市长想让草地灌溉效率最大化，机械师用测量结果说明最大水量不等于最佳方案。
在此同时，媒体追问奖章为何颁给设计者。水泵机械式重复动作，真正修理的人却没有被提及。
云岚调解争执，使可测量改进成为有意义的标准。午后测试显示，修理而非空洞目标提供了救田手段，奖章最终属于机械师。

A [[phrase]] about miraculous strength misread the subject’s [[physical]] reaction. He was [[physically]] affected by smoke; the change was [[physiological]]. The exhibit entered a safer [[phase]], protecting animals and people instead of selling false wonder.

title: 码头上的腌菜针
englishTitle: The Pickle Needle at the Pier
mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 码头野餐上，馅饼与腌菜被人下毒。鸽子落在柱旁，猪也在食物堆边停步，药师看见一根针刺穿盒盖。
巡礼者头枕枕头，服药丸后发晕。飞行员摘下胸针，用小夹子取出毒针；松树下粉色饮料也要检查。
一品脱菠萝汁里藏着异常成分。云岚让虔诚信徒别拒绝医治，宗门护卫查清出入记录，野餐者全部得救。
en: At a [[picnic]] on a [[pier]], a [[pie]] and a [[pickle]] were poisoned. A [[pigeon]] settled on a [[pillar]], while a [[pig]] sniffed the food [[pile]]. Yun saw a needle [[pierce]] a lid.

A [[pilgrim]] rested on a [[pillow]], dizzy after one [[pill]]. A [[pilot]] removed a [[pin]] from his coat and used it to lift the needle with a careful [[pinch]]. Under a [[pine]], a [[pink]] drink waited untouched.

One [[pint]] of [[pineapple]] juice held the same chemical. The [[pious]] traveler accepted treatment while guards checked who had approached the table. Everyone survived, and the hidden supplier faced the evidence.

englishTitle: The Planetary Pipeline on the Plateau
mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 高原的工厂号称行星动力能治瘟疫，海盗却借口抢走管道零件。活塞与手枪被丢进坑，地面管道失压。
平原上的种植园供给塑料平台，表面涂石膏，设计看似合理。云岚解释行星轨道不可能凭空给这台机器力量，广告只是宣传术语。
她检查管中沥青，阻止继续抽水。瘟疫需治而非神迹，工人安全修好管道，海盗所谓拯救者身份被揭穿。
en: On a [[plateau]], a [[pipeline]] supposedly used [[planetary]] power to cure [[plague]]. A [[pirate]] stole a [[pipe]], then hid a [[pistol]] and [[piston]] in a [[pit]].

On the [[plain]], a [[plantation]] supplied a [[plastic]] [[platform]] coated with [[plaster]]. The design seemed [[plausible]]. Yun explained that a [[planet]]’s [[orbit]] could not give this machine celestial power.
She found [[pitch]] blocking the pipe and stopped the pump. Safe repairs restored water, while doctors treated the real disease. The pirate’s claim to be a savior failed with the false advertisement.

云岚拔下气动泵插头，发现犁地用水被偷。充足粮食不意味着可以任意拿走，阴谋在复数收据中出现。
她提出多元制度让居民共同决定。加上真正还款，富豪的保证才有效；村民有了足够粮食，孩子再度回到操场。
en: A [[player]] at a [[playground]] made a [[plea]] to a [[plutocrat]], beginning to [[plead]] for an end to [[plunder]]. The [[plump]] man gave a [[pleasant]] [[pledge]], then sent workers to [[plunge]] into the store and steal grain.

Yun pulled a [[plug]] from the [[pneumatic]] pump. Water for fields worked with a [[plough]] had been diverted. [[plentiful|Plentiful]] grain did not justify theft. A [[plural]] set of receipts exposed the [[plot]]; one worker tried to [[pluck]] them away.

A rule of [[pluralism]], [[plus]] actual repayment, made the pledge meaningful. There was [[plenty]] for everyone. Children returned to play, and villagers finally controlled the water their fields needed.

警方不凭诗歌裁决，巡使轻戳包装，发现聚合物壳内污染物。有人为让商品受欢迎，宣传其能消除污染。
民意调查使政策改变。林澈擦亮标签，证明污染来自港池，民众不再只听政治口号；诗仍流行，重要的是其中证据可核验。

The [[police]] could not judge by [[poetry]]. Lin gave the [[polymer]] shell a [[poke]], exposing a [[pollutant]]. A [[politician]] hoped to [[popularize]] it as a cure for [[pollution]], although it would [[pollute]] the water.

cn: 港口给搬运工提供粥，却有人把份额偷偷扣走。门廊上的瓷碗旁，一幅肖像描绘葡萄牙厨师，试图让大家怀疑他。
便携机器统计港口人口与捐赠者人气，微小毛孔般的小孔却漏出水。池塘旁气泡啪地破裂，暴露隐藏排水管。
林澈沉思后要求实际位置测量，厨师以积极态度配合。人们终于确知肖像姿势只是照相姿态，扣粮者被查明，工人领回食物。
en: At the [[port]], a [[porter]] received too small a [[portion]] of [[porridge]]. On a [[porch]], a [[porcelain]] bowl stood beside a [[portrait]] meant to [[portray]] a [[portuguese|Portuguese]] cook as a thief.
A [[portable]] machine counted the [[population]] and a donor’s [[popularity]]. A tiny [[pore]] in its tank leaked. Bubbles would [[pop]] in a nearby [[pond]], revealing the hidden drain.

Lin chose to [[ponder]] the evidence and measure the tank’s [[position]]. The cook’s [[positive]] response helped [[positively]] identify the leak. His photographic [[pose]] proved nothing. The actual thief returned the stolen meals.

englishTitle: The Postman and the Pot of Possibilities
mood: 疑虑 → 发现 → 释然
cn: 邮差把邮票、海报和一口锅送到学堂。老师说不能仅因拥有东西就证明所有权，未来存在可能，也不代表已成事实。
邮政检查发现家禽被关在包裹里。学生试图用姿态与传闻推断老师行骗，老师却让他们先提出可检验的假设。
活动被延期，鸡群回到原主，锅也物归其主。教宗捐赠函经核实不是赝品，未来的潜力应在关照生命中兑现。
en: A [[postman]] delivered a [[poster]], paid [[postage]], and a [[pot]] to the school. To [[possess]] an object did not prove rightful [[possession]]. A future [[possibility]] did not mean it would [[possibly]] happen tomorrow.

A [[postal]] check found live [[poultry]] in a sealed parcel. Students read the teacher’s [[posture]] as guilt; he asked them to [[postulate]] a testable claim instead. A donation letter bearing the [[pope|Pope]]’s seal needed verification too.

They chose to [[postpone]] the show and return the birds. The letter proved genuine, and the pot went to its owner. Real [[potential]] began with caring for living things rather than making grand predictions.
